prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1036; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presented with scraping and paint transfer along the right rear quarter panel, a cracked rear bumper cover at the right corner, and a dented right rear door skin with a damaged mirror housing. The pattern of contact runs along the body in the direction you would expect from a sideswipe during a lane change, and the damage is largely consistent with the impact as described. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, repairing and refinishing the door and quarter panel, and replacing the mirror housing. The labor hours requested fit the scope of this work. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle, and the invoices reviewed show no duplicate charges for the same parts or labor.
